headquarters: San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato, Mexico

mines.mine_notes: 100% rights (exploration and exploitation) to five contiguous concessions in the Guanajuato silver belt. Large primary silver-gold greenfield discovery (~182 km of identified mineralized strike), concealed beneath clay cover; adjacent to Fresnillo's advanced exploration project. 60,810-m Phase 1 surface drilling program completed; Phase 2 targeting additional 122,000 m; exploration decline construction to begin 2H 2026. Commercial production targeted ~2031; no mine plan established. No production or revenue (net loss US$18.7M in 2025).

notes: Pre-production silver explorer; no FY2025 production or revenue. Backed by Electrum Group (Thomas Kaplan); executive chair Daniel Muñiz Quintanilla; country manager Fabián Galindo. Q1 2026 net loss US$11.6M. Added to GDXJ at the Sept 18, 2026 rebalance.
